titles.title: legacy review is refused until a fresh bound review covers the latest build
a stale review can be explicitly overridden in both completion gates
review coverage must include every BUILD path, with absolute and relative paths equivalent
a bound review detects changed commits and tasks even at the same timestamp, but survives approval bookkeeping
legacy reviews without a BUILD binding are rejected regardless of their review timestamps
an existing structurally invalid BUILD cannot satisfy completion with a passing review
a legacy review cannot establish freshness for an undated BUILD
completion refuses a malformed review even when an empty BUILD has no file coverage to check
a stale BUILD review does not prevent approval of a new PLAN
single BUILD target with no prior json creates the record, but completes only after its code review
non-BUILD (LLD) target => no BUILD json is written (the hook is BUILD-scoped)
the persisted review binds the BUILD snapshot that was reviewed
runCodeReview: all four judges returning findings persist ONE record with dimensions:[four] + folded verdict + counts (ac1)
runCodeReview: verdict fold matches the ReviewVerdict vocabulary (any-HIGH=>block, MED-no-HIGH=>warn, only-LOW/empty=>pass) (ac2)
runCodeReview: the record is written at CR-<epic>-<story> and carries kind:code-review (ac3)
runCodeReview: the four judges run SERIALLY in [adherence,conventions,coverage,quality] order, never concurrently (ac4)
runCodeReview: a throwing 2nd judge aborts the run with {ok:false} and writes NOTHING; judges 3-4 do not run (ac5)
runCodeReview: an in-memory validation failure returns {ok:false} before any write (ac5)
runCodeReview: a pre-aborted signal returns {ok:false} and writes nothing (ac5)
runCodeReview: a grounding failure returns {ok:false} and writes nothing (ac5)
runCodeReview: a successful run writes BOTH the .json and the .md (two write-spy calls)
runCodeReview: all four dimensions empty => a written PASS record (an empty review is a persisted PASS, not an absence)
T4 runCodeReview given reviewedBy controller writes it on the record
T4 runCodeReview given reviewedBy daemon writes it on the record
T4 runCodeReview given no reviewedBy writes none
DEFAULT_DEPS: wires the base four judges + conditional functional-coverage + diagram + ux, in fixed order + writeAtomic
s10: runCodeReview with opts.groundingMode:degraded stamps body.groundingMode === degraded
s10: capVerdictAtWarn:true + all-empty findings (would fold pass) => verdict warn
s10: capVerdictAtWarn:true + a HIGH finding => verdict stays block (the cap never lowers block/warn)
s10 ac6: runCodeReview with NO groundingMode/cap opts stamps full and the verdict fold is unchanged (default parity)
the review record stamps excludedFromScope beside changedFiles when uncommitted files were left out, and omits it when none were
